command: $sample=[ordered]@{Time=(Get-Date -Format o);Tcp=@(Get-NetTCPConnection | Group-Object State | Select-Object Name,Count);Processes=@(Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -in @("python","msedge","node") } | Select-Object ProcessName,Id,Handles,WorkingSet64,CPU);Memory=(Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object TotalVisibleMemorySize,FreePhysicalMemory,TotalVirtualMemorySize,FreeVirtualMemory)}; $sample | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4; exit 0
